failure_modes: Selecting a temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011) would add an observed-teacher coordinate reward whose validated absolute contrast is not established, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates without demonstrated affinity benefit.
Selecting a pointcloud_delta_A value (C001-C003) would alter distance-response curvature without supplied spatial-scale or uncertainty evidence, changing the reward shape in an unsupported direction.

Changing teacher_neighbors (C005-C007) or region_index (C004) would alter teacher mixture/attention coverage without intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence, and neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth.
Treating a temporal derivative or a coordinate contrast as a spatial gradient or physical interaction energy would misstate the reward semantics and could drive spurious coordinate motion.
Any temperature edit would be an interface violation; the fixed mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 are preserved.
rationale: Objective is affinity-primary with coordinate control only, and the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP; coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies or affinity-head derivatives (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1, E0857891f4effbfe1). The observed support is the score window [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times, and terminal score/state times lie outside it, so no decoded terminal affinity label is available to justify a change (E0857891f4effbfe1). The information audit states its metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that teacher score correlations are observational, not a validated affinity predictor (E2bb8390452ed517a). Survival/lineage credit is accounting over 14 batches with heavy sparse-ancestor coverage and is explicitly not terminal affinity benefit (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1). Curve support selects 24 features under a fidelity rule, but its audit contents were delivered only as a container summary and were not read numerically, so per-feature fidelity is unavailable (Ed4e7d28e7b0423e0). The landmark_00 continuous trends are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed and polynomial not accepted, showing multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts with relative node RMSE from about 0.29 to 0.87 (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb, E598d52f84227fbcc, E1ba2a68ba5243c03, E5cf1ecb7c628685b, E5d1c4c6e5dbe0cb6). H001's time-conditioned regional attention idea is not yet defensible: the sign change is not shown to survive independent-batch resampling and the fidelity values needed to check its falsifier were not read. H002 already argues against prioritizing the local derivative/curvature descriptors. Among the registered choices, the temporal_teacher_blend options (C009-C011) would mix in an observed-teacher coordinate reward whose validated contrast is not established here, and the pointcloud_delta_A options (C001-C003) change distance-response curvature without supplied spatial-scale or uncertainty evidence to justify a specific value; teacher_neighbors (C005-C007) and region_index (C004) are not supported by intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence read in this turn. Since no registered edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first priority, retaining the incumbent is the correct bounded choice.
